$comment: motion.easingEmphasized is a light spring (about 4% overshoot) for position, size and shape; keep colour and opacity on the standard easing. Canopy is the flagship brand: the theme to show first and to reach for on new work. cre8 stays the default a surface gets when it asks for nothing, so existing consumers do not change. Seeds are OKLCH; the hex in each description is an approximate sRGB reading.
name: canopy
description: The flagship brand. A greenhouse for software: forest green on olive-tinted neutrals with an orchid accent, 12px corners, olive-tinted shadows, Google Sans Flex with Bricolage Grotesque headings.

primary.$description: Forest green (about #15803d): buttons, links, focus, brand fills.

neutral.$description: Olive-stone (about #76776a). The olive tint warms surfaces, borders and text without turning them cream.

accent.$description: Orchid (about #c46a9a): highlights, charts, the far end of the brand gradient. For text use the 700 step.

info.$description: Steel teal-blue, so info does not read as the orchid accent or as success.

success.$description: Jade teal (about #009689), shifted away from the primary green. Always pair with an icon and a label.

error.$description: Signal red (about #dc2626), well away from the orchid accent.

chart.$description: Olive. Forest, olive and terracotta are close for red-green colour blindness: label series directly.

radius.$description: Cards and containers. Half of cre8's 24px.

buttonRadius.$description: Soft-square buttons, not pills: the clearest shape difference from cre8.

shadowColor.$description: Shadows carry the neutral's olive hue instead of grey.

avoid: sparkle emoji as an AI signifier
